title: Grammar Edit — Sentence Repair
description: Practice choosing the correct edit for each underlined section.

questions.prompt: The manager, along with the two new hires, {{blank}} attending the safety training on Monday.
questions.explanation: The subject is 'the manager' (singular) — the phrase 'along with the two new hires' doesn't change subject-verb agreement, so the verb stays singular: 'is'.

questions.prompt: Each of the applicants must submit {{blank}} resume by Friday.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular, so a singular possessive pronoun is required in formal usage: 'his or her'.
